title: Typed origin-bound Ribasim realization receipt
problem: The RM09 executable fixture proves the causal sequence, but the production-facing RM06 forcing constructor still accepts detached scalar allocated_depth_cm and supplied_depth_cm values. That permits accidental cross-origin mixing that the type system cannot detect.
scope: Introduce provenance and admission plumbing only. Do not change irrigation physics, Rutter physics, Ribasim allocation logic or partial-supply policy.
requirements: The RM07 demand receipt retains and can return an immutable copy of the complete TCS1/DCS2 request used to derive it.

A typed Ribasim realization receipt binds SWAP management lineage, SWAP management revision, crop-origin revision, management interval and requested depth to an opaque coupler-owned Ribasim origin id and revision.
Allocated and physically supplied depths remain separate fields.
The first admitted realization profile requires full allocation within 1e-6 cm and full physical supply within 1e-4 cm, exactly matching RM09 qualification tolerances.
The receipt carries the Ribasim full-realization precondition evidence: source-level margin, level-difference threshold and physical low-storage factor.
The full-realization receipt fails closed unless margin >= 3 * level_difference_threshold and low_storage_factor = 1 within numerical tolerance.

Preparing RM06 forcing from a realization receipt requires exact provenance match to the RM07 demand receipt and uses the request copy from that receipt; no detached allocation or supply scalar enters the forcing API.
A realization receipt from another management lineage, revision, crop revision or interval is rejected.
A receipt with supplied < allocated outside the RM09 tolerance remains rejected; RM10 does not create a partial-irrigation policy.
Same origin plus same values reproduces an identical typed receipt and the existing RM06 candidate replay/commit behavior.
falsification_conditions: The forcing can be constructed with realization values detached from the demand origin.
A mismatched lineage/revision/interval/crop origin is accepted.
The full request cannot be reconstructed from the RM07 receipt.
A partial physical realization outside the RM09 tolerance is admitted.
The typed route changes RM06 requested, allocated, supplied or net-applied numerical outcomes relative to the already qualified scalar route.
nonclaims: The opaque Ribasim origin id is coupler provenance, not a Ribasim product checkpoint API.
No canonical admission by RM10 alone.
